682:t_2:29.en:
$$ベック$$
「Never mind that. You, the huge little lady over there... You know, don't you?」

682:t_2:30.en:
$$ベック$$
「That the real name of your idol $$ノノリリ$$ is $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「But she's nothing like the $$ノノリリ$$ $$ノノ$$ told us about!」

682:t_2:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wasn't $$ノノリリ$$ supposed to have long, beautiful hair, a knockout figure, and the smile of a Madonna!?」

682:t_2:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I think that's probably because, over the long years, my images of $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$ got mixed up in $$ノノ$$'s mind.」

682:t_2:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But now I'm certain. The girl who fought carrying the future of humanity on her back, $$ノノリリ$$... She was $$ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:38.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then our world wasn't a parallel world to $$ノリコ$$'s world, but an age far in the future...?」

682:t_2:39.en:
$$ベック$$
「Looks like that's the case. Apparently something like 12,000 years have gone by.」

682:t_2:40.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「How is it that you know that?」

682:t_2:41.en:
$$ベック$$
「I saw the materials on some ruins at the edge of the solar system, back when I was with $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$. He... or rather, the $$サイデリアル$$ got hold of them.」

682:t_2:42.en:
$$ベック$$
「Turns out that was a collection of technology that one of the worlds inside $$翠の地球$$ sealed away in the past.」

682:t_2:43.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So it came from our world's past... in other words, from $$ノリコ$$'s era.」

682:t_2:44.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ and I weren't flung into a parallel world. We drifted ashore in the future, 12,000 years later...」

682:t_2:45.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now it all makes sense. Even why the $$バスター軍団$$ had a degeneracy reactor that $$ガンバスター$$ can use, too.」

682:t_2:46.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our world forgot about the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and took the $$バスター軍団$$ for the legendary $$宇宙怪獣$$, didn't it...」

682:t_2:47.en:
$$ベック$$
「Looks that way. On top of that, since the old technology was dangerous, they built up a totally new system of technology from scratch.」

682:t_2:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And that's our $$バスターマシン$$s, using the power of $$トップレス$$...」

682:t_2:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! You knew all that, so why did you keep quiet!?」

682:t_2:51.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She was the $$ノノリリ$$ you idolized, wasn't she! You could have called $$ノリコ$$ your Big Sis instead of someone like me!」

682:t_2:52.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ was the same as you, Big Sis... I grew sick of myself for not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$...」

682:t_2:54.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So $$ノノ$$ had decided to forget about $$ノノリリ$$ and just go on living...」

682:t_2:55.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's a lie! You were always giving it everything you had! With hard work and guts!」

682:t_2:56.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Unlike me, who despaired when you left me behind, you kept moving forward!」

682:t_2:57.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's why I... you were so dazzling to me...」

682:t_2:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But you kept on fighting, Big Sis... Without ever running away, with hard work and guts...」

682:t_2:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So after all, you are $$ノノリリ$$, Big Sis... You're my idol.」

682:t_2:61.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It's always like this, really... I guess $$ノノ$$ is hopeless after all...」

682:t_2:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No matter how great a power $$ノノ$$ gets her hands on, she's still just a flame... If a big wind comes, she wavers right away.」

682:t_2:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But if you were here with me, Big Sis...」

682:t_2:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Get out of the way, No. 7!! Don't get in my way!!」

682:t_2:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't rely on you when I don't even know where you came from! This is humanity's fight!」

682:t_2:68.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Humanity will survive even if it means abandoning the Earth! I don't know whether that's right or not...! You have nothing to do with it!」

682:t_2:69.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You, who don't even know how I feel...! You!!」

682:t_2:71.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If you'd just stayed my friend, that would have been enough! I wanted you to call me $$ラルク$$, not Big Sis!」

682:t_2:72.en:
$$ラルク$$
「And yet you! You kept getting stronger all by yourself, and left me behind...!」

682:t_2:74.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... I can't be the one you look up to! I can't be $$ノノリリ$$!」

682:t_2:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$... is the same for $$ノノ$$...」

682:t_2:78.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wanted to be like you, Big Sis... I've always envied you...」

682:t_2:79.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because... you look so much like $$ノノリリ$$, Big Sis...」

682:t_2:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You see, $$ノノリリ$$ isn't special... She's just an ordinary girl...」

682:t_2:82.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understood that well by actually fighting alongside $$ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ is the real name of the $$ノノリリ$$ I idolized.」

682:t_2:87.en:
$$シン$$
「But she's nothing like the $$ノノリリ$$ $$ノノ$$ told us about!」

682:t_2:88.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wasn't $$ノノリリ$$ supposed to have long, beautiful hair, a knockout figure, and the smile of a Madonna!?」

682:t_2:89.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I think that's probably because, over the long years, my images of $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$ got mixed up in $$ノノ$$'s mind.」

682:t_2:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But now I'm certain. The girl who fought carrying the future of humanity on her back, $$ノノリリ$$... She was $$ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:91.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then our world wasn't a parallel world to $$ノリコ$$'s world, but an age far in the future...?」

682:t_2:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So it seems... Apparently about 12,000 years have passed.」

682:t_2:93.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Princess, where did you hear that?」

682:t_2:94.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I heard it at the $$枢密参謀院$$ after the Galactic Raid Fleet set out...」

682:t_2:95.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The technology used in $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ is apparently the same as that of the ruins at the edge of the solar system.」

682:t_2:96.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So it came from our world's past... in other words, from $$ノリコ$$'s era.」

682:t_2:97.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ and I weren't flung into a parallel world. We drifted ashore in the future, 12,000 years later...」

682:t_2:98.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now it all makes sense. Even why the $$バスター軍団$$ had a degeneracy reactor that $$ガンバスター$$ can use, too.」

682:t_2:99.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our world forgot about the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and took the $$バスター軍団$$ for the legendary $$宇宙怪獣$$, didn't it...」

682:t_2:100.en:
$$ラルク$$
「They say that since the technology of $$ノリコ$$'s era was dangerous, the people of later ages built a completely new system of technology.」

682:t_2:101.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And that's our $$バスターマシン$$s, using the power of $$トップレス$$...」

682:t_2:103.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$... You knew that, didn't you?」

682:t_2:104.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... From about the time I got the power of $$バスターマシン７号$$ back, my memories gradually came back too...」

682:t_2:106.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She was the $$ノノリリ$$ you idolized, wasn't she! You could have called $$ノリコ$$ your Big Sis instead of someone like me!」

682:t_2:107.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ was the same as you, Big Sis... I grew sick of myself for not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$...」
